verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing says it can automatically capture and route leads to sales managers, and that automated actions can fire on CRM field changes or user activity. That covers the core idea of automatic lead routing. However, the evidence is a single marketing line, with no documentation of configurable assignment rules, round-robin distribution, or how the owner is chosen. Missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, round-robin or load-balanced distribution, details on owner-matching criteria, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin

citations.quote: Automatically capture and route leads to sales managers for faster follow-up.
Launch automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity.
